about.title: About RMC
about.subtitle: Rwanda Muslim Community — Building a United Ummah

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To unite and serve the Muslim community in Rwanda through digital innovation, promoting Islamic values, education, and social welfare.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A digitally empowered, unified, and prosperous Muslim community contributing to the development of Rwanda.

history.title: Our History
history.text: The Rwanda Muslim Community has been serving Muslims across Rwanda since its founding. With a network spanning all provinces and districts, RMC coordinates religious, educational, and social services for over 500,000 Muslims nationwide.

values.title: Our Values
values.unityDesc: Bringing Muslims together across all regions of Rwanda
values.educationDesc: Promoting Islamic and secular education for all members
values.serviceDesc: Providing essential services to community members in need
values.transparencyDesc: Open and accountable governance of community resources

services.title: Community Services
services.subtitle: RMC offers 7 core services to support our community

marriage.title: Marriage Services
marriage.desc: Official Islamic marriage ceremonies, certificates, and documentation for couples in the community.

funeral.title: Funeral Services
funeral.desc: Coordination of Islamic burial rites, imam assignment, and logistics support for families.

conduct.title: Good Conduct Certificate
conduct.desc: Official certificates of good Islamic conduct for members — required for various administrative processes.

scholarship.title: Scholarships
scholarship.desc: Financial support for Muslim students pursuing education at all levels.

hijra.title: Hijra Support
hijra.desc: Documentation and support services for community relocation and migration needs.

tender.title: Tenders
tender.desc: Business opportunities published by RMC for qualified organizations and contractors.
